long_biography.plain_text:
Through Yanköşe, chocolate executive Dilara Altınkılıç Kutmangil has helped select artworks for public display in Istanbul. The project invites artists to respond to its urban setting, with proposals assessed by a committee that includes designers, critics and curators. Displays include temporary works by Turkish and international artists.

At Detay Gıda, her emphasis on longstanding supplier relationships has extended to developing products together. She has favoured retaining specialist suppliers while seeking efficiencies in logistics and factory operations. Frutibon, a confectionery product made with real strawberries, took two years of collaboration with a raw-material supplier.
